menu.title: Lermoos
menu.blurb: A real place: Lermoos. Only what really stands there is built: the roads and gravel tracks and the lifts. 75,000 € to start, enough for a first T-bar, and the first trails are yours to draw.

welcome.title: Welcome to {park}!
paragraphs: This is a real place: Lermoos. Nothing has been made up here: what you see standing is what really stands there, and the gravel tracks are the real ones.
The lifts here are the real ones too. Guests arrive on the track at the edge of your land.

1. Hire a worker or two in the Crew menu (C). Your crew builds everything you plan.
2. Press T to draw your first trail: start on a gravel track, wind across the slope and end on a track or lift further down. Press Enter and the crew gets to work.
Steep real slopes rate trails harder, so use switchbacks. Every trail and feature earns XP. New park levels unlock harder features, more land and bigger lifts. Good luck!
